threads.body:
@copilot Update this PR directly with these two test-only simplifications. Preserve the production behavior and existing PR state; do not create another PR.

In instrumentation/apache-dubbo-2.7/javaagent/src/testDubbo/java/io/opentelemetry/javaagent/instrumentation/apachedubbo/v2_7/DubboAgentTest.java, replace the recording ambient and remote fixture spans used by the new parenting tests with a fixed sampled, non-recording Span.wrap(...) ambient parent and the existing fixed TRACEPARENT for propagated remote parenting. These tests need parent IDs, not exported fixture spans. Each parenting case should export exactly one server span, with assertions checking the expected trace ID and parent span ID, or no parent when neither exists. Remove the recording-span factory, generated traceparent helper, fixture span-ending blocks, comparator, and four-way trace-layout assertions made unnecessary by this change. Keep all four ambient/remote combinations for binary attachments and Triple headers, both decode cases, and the non-span baggage preservation assertions. Retain the separate real-filter suppression test unchanged in purpose.

In instrumentation/aws-lambda/aws-lambda-core-1.0/library/src/test/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/awslambdacore/v1_0/internal/InstrumenterExtractionTest.java, narrow extractPreservesAmbientContext to one focused test with an ambient span, a context key, and a propagated remote parent. Verify that the remote parent wins, the context key survives, and extraction leaves the current context unchanged. Remove the parameterized matrix and conditional setup for this test. The new real-handler tests already cover ambient-parent fallback and context-value preservation. Retain the object/stream x success/failure handler cases in AwsLambdaTest because the handlers have separate scope-management implementations.

Limit changes to these test simplifications and directly necessary test cleanup. Preserve all three Dubbo rejection-path tests, installed-agent coverage, supported dependency-version coverage, and existing propagation/suppression semantics. Run the narrow relevant tests, including the configured Dubbo preview-semconv variants and relevant baseline/latest dependency coverage where feasible. Do not change PR titles or descriptions.

replies.body: Implemented the test simplifications in 80bda0fb; formatting follow-up is in 947746ae. Baseline Dubbo preview/duplicate-semconv and Lambda tests pass. The latest-dependency run was blocked because JDK 27 could not be provisioned in this sandbox.

threads.body:
@copilot Update this PR directly to remove all newly added test code while retaining its production changes and contributor guidance. This is a user-directed scope revision that supersedes the earlier request to retain the new ambient-context test matrices. Treat the change as alignment with the existing context-preservation convention, not a demonstrated application-specific regression needing new module-specific coverage. Do not create another PR.

Remove every test addition introduced by this PR from instrumentation/apache-dubbo-2.7/javaagent/src/testDubbo/java/io/opentelemetry/javaagent/instrumentation/apachedubbo/v2_7/DubboAgentTest.java, instrumentation/aws-lambda/aws-lambda-core-1.0/library/src/test/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/awslambdacore/v1_0/AwsLambdaTest.java, and instrumentation/aws-lambda/aws-lambda-core-1.0/library/src/test/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/awslambdacore/v1_0/internal/InstrumenterExtractionTest.java. This includes the new Dubbo binary/Triple/decode parenting cases, suppression case, fixture constants and helpers, Lambda handler lifecycle matrix, Lambda extraction test, and their now-unused imports. Preserve all tests and infrastructure that existed before this PR. These three files should no longer differ from this PR's merge-base versions; do not compare against the latest main tip or overwrite unrelated changes.

Keep the four root-to-current production context-selection changes, removal of the incompatible Lambda context-leak diagnostic, the context-propagation contributor article and index entry, and all explanatory comment corrections, including the comment-only change in AbstractDubboTest.java. Do not change production behavior further, delete pre-existing regression tests, or add replacement ambient-context tests or test machinery.

Rely on the existing Lambda and Dubbo integration regression coverage. Run the narrow relevant existing regression tests where feasible. The resulting PR diff should contain the production and guidance/comment changes, with none of the newly introduced test methods, fixtures, or imports remaining.

replies.body: Done in 190ea09c. The three requested test files now match the merge-base; production, contributor guidance, and the AbstractDubboTest comment change are unchanged. The targeted existing Lambda and Dubbo tests passed.

threads.body: [Testing] The existing unknown-service tests do not establish ambient context on the rejecting server thread, leaving the new parenting and suppression behavior untested. Add installed-agent regression coverage for getInvoker, decode, and Triple rejection with ambient parenting and suppression; install context on the thread executing the rejection, not only around the client call. For the attachment and Triple extraction paths, also verify remote-parent precedence while retaining an unrelated context value.

replies.body: The missing ambient-context coverage is intentional. This PR aligns these rejection paths with the existing request-parenting convention and relies on the existing integration regressions. The synthetic ambient-context tests were removed in 190ea09c as a scope decision; reintroducing them would undo that decision.

threads.body: [Testing] The core handler tests and `InstrumenterExtractionTest` never invoke extraction with an ambient caller context, so they do not distinguish this behavior from the previous `Context.root()` implementation. Please add regression coverage through a handler for inheriting the caller span without propagation and preferring a remote parent while retaining an unrelated context value. Also verify that an ambient suppression context still prevents an invocation span, since preserving suppression is part of this change's contract.

replies.body: We're deliberately relying on the existing Lambda regression tests for this context-preservation consistency change. The new ambient-parent, remote-parent, and context-preservation tests were removed in 190ea09c after deciding not to add module-specific ambient-context coverage here. This coverage suggestion does not identify a correctness defect, so I'm keeping the agreed scope.
